title: 성평등가족부 소관 비상대비자원 관리법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20251001:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family) <Ordinance No. 1, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (11) Omitted.

(12) The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Management of Emergency Preparedness Resources under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family shall be partially amended as follows:

The title "Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Management of Emergency Preparedness Resources under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family" shall be substituted for the former title.

In Article 1, the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 2, subparagraph 5 of the same Article, the former part of Article 4, and attached Form 1, respectively, "Minister of Gender Equality and Family" shall be substituted for the former ministerial title.

(13) through <22> Omitted.
